notes.title: Full Version - v1.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello coffee lovers![/b]

This announcement comes to thank you, apologize for some things and share new developments.

[b]Full Version of Coffee Express is Live![/b]

On January 10th, we started this journey with early access, and today we have reached an important milestone with the release of Coffee Express version 1.0. This was made possible thanks to the support of the Coffee Express community. We would like to sincerely thank everyone who has stood by us for the last two months, supported us on different platforms and shared their views.

[b]Pricing and Future Plans[/b]

We would like to share an important point for new coffee lovers: There will be no change in the price of Coffee Express. The game will continue to be available on Steam at the list price we set for early access.
As for the future of Coffee Express, as we mentioned above, we will take into account the feedback from our community for improvements. However, we would like to emphasize that most of our energy will now be spent on our new game, which we will announce soon. In this process, your support will be more valuable to us than ever. Thank you once again for all your contributions! Last but not least, here's what's coming to Coffee Express with the full release:

- Some minor bugs have been fixed.
- Brazilian Portuguese language has been added.
- Added an accessory shop where you can buy accessories for your shop.
- Updated the making stages of some coffees.
- New coffee equipment has been added.

notes.title: Roadmap Update - v0.1.4
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This has been a long-awaited update, and we sincerely apologize to our Coffee Express followers for the delay. We hope this update will make it worth the wait. With this release, we’ve taken steps on most of the items in our roadmap and added new features. You can now make flavored coffees (currently latte and mocha) and serve desserts to customers. As a result, cups and plates will get dirty, and you’ll need to collect and wash them in the dishwasher. We’ve also made radical changes to speed up the gameplay. This update aims to fulfill many of our full-release goals.

- Fixed some minor bugs.
- Addressed various animation issues.
- Removed the end-of-day waiting period to speed up gameplay.
- Added a dishwasher, microwave, kettle, and more.
- Added dessert service.
- Added flavored coffees, increasing the number of coffee recipes.
- Added new achievements.
- Added new environmental objects.

notes.title: Gameplay and Interface Update - v0.1.3
notes.content:
Hello, first of all, we would like to apologize to our valuable Coffee Express followers for bringing this update late compared to other updates. Based on the feedback, annoyances and some complaints since the release, we have made some changes in this update to speed up the gameplay a bit. We have also adjusted coffee packs and milk packs so that they can be used twice. We have added more indicators and new menu elements because some actions did not have enough guidance. We have sped up some animations and removed some of them completely. In this update, we aimed to provide a clear and fluid gameplay.

- Fixed some minor bugs.
- Updated gameplay mechanics.
- Increased the usability of milk and coffee packs.
- Animation updates have been made.
- Added new interface indicators.
- Added new coffee order dialogs.
- Added new environmental objects.

notes.title: Mini Gameplay Update - v0.1.2
notes.content:
We've received a lot of feedback that the number of customers per day in Coffee Express was insufficient and that there was nothing left to do for the rest of the day. Therefore, we increased the number of customers per day. Additionally, to allow players to experiment more with latte and mocha art and to avoid turning away customers, we increased the number of porcelain cups. We also adjusted the frequency of floor dirtiness. In this version, we aim to deliver a more stable gameplay experience.

- Fixed some minor bugs.
- Increased the number of customers per day.
- Updated the frequency of floor dirtiness.
- Increased the number of porcelain cups.

notes.title: First Day Update - v0.1.1
notes.content:
We've seen some bugs when playing Coffee Express (especially when throwing garbage). As Fat Cat Interactive, we apologize for not being able to test these enough and for the inconvenience this has caused you. We've only updated this patch to fix some minor bugs, and we've also added a reminder to close the door at the end of the day.

- Bug fixing.
- Added end of day reminder.
